name: Kim
bio: Kim has worked as a Dog Trainer since 2020 and joined the Obedience Unleashed Team in 2022. She brings 7 years of experience in the Hospitality Industry and is enthusiastic about connecting with dog owners to really listen to their needs and tailor training for their dogs. At home you can find her practicing Agility with her Lab Maya or working in Rally-Obedience with her Belgian Malinois Luca.
